title: VQ-CSDN: A Vector Quantized Content-Stain Decoupling Network for Stain Normalization of H&E Histopathology Images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《VQ-CSDN: A Vector Quantized Content-Stain Decoupling Network for Stain Normalization of H&E Histopathology Images》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Stain normalization is a fundamental preprocessing technique in digital and computational pathology, and it is important for improving the consistency of clinical diagnosis by reducing color heterogeneity.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《VQ-CSDN: A Vector Quantized Content-Stain Decoupling Network for Stain Normalization of H&E Histopathology Images》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】However, existing stain normalization methods are often limited by content-stain entanglement and an ambiguously modeled content-stain relationship, resulting in unstable structural preservation, cross-center adaptation burden, and sensitivity to template selection.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Extensive experiments on multiple public and private pathology datasets show that VQ-CSDN consistently enhances normalization quality, reflected by increased SSIM/PSNR and decreased FID, and further improves downstream benign-malignant classification performance (AUC 0.9738) over state-of-the-art methods.

evidence.text: However, existing stain normalization methods are often limited by content-stain entanglement and an ambiguously modeled content-stain relationship, resulting in unstable structural preservation, cross-center adaptation burden, and sensitivity to template selection.

Extensive experiments on multiple public and private pathology datasets show that VQ-CSDN consistently enhances normalization quality, reflected by increased SSIM/PSNR and decreased FID, and further improves downstream benign-malignant classification performance (AUC 0.9738) over state-of-the-art methods.
